description: Exact count of matching businesses, with how many have a verified email, an owner's name or no website, and the top cities. Free. Use this first to answer 'how many'.

active_since_days.description: Only businesses with a Google review in the last N days (90 is a good default).

email_quality.description: 'valid' = confirmed by the mail server (default); 'valid_or_risky' adds catch-all domains.

has_email.description: Only rows with an email of email_quality.

has_owner.description: Only rows with an owner's name.

new_within_days.description: Only listings that appeared on Google Maps after their area's first scrape, first seen in the last N days (30 is a good default).

no_analytics.description: Only sites whose homepage was read and has no Google Analytics or tag manager.

no_booking.description: Only sites whose homepage was read and shows no online booking.

no_fb_pixel.description: Only sites whose homepage was read and has no Facebook pixel.

q.description: Plain-English search, e.g. 'roofers in Dallas TX with no website'. Explicit fields below override what the sentence says.

site_cms.description: Site platform, comma-separated: wordpress, wix, squarespace, godaddy, weebly, duda, shopify, webflow, custom, or diy (any DIY site builder).

site_dead.description: Only businesses whose website is down.
